plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's identity. The trine lets them flow together easily.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your sense of self, confidence, and direction.
summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your sense of self, confidence, and direction. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The risk is the usual one with easy contacts: because the warmth comes naturally, neither person may think to deepen it or take care of it. A connection this pleasant can drift on autopilot.
advice: Enjoy the ease, but keep offering something real. Pleasant is a gift, not a substitute for effort.
